# JPMorgan and Bank of America 2024 Annual Performance and Outlook Testability

**Insufficient evidence**

JPM revenue for the fiscal period ended 2024-12-31 was $177.556 billion [E330195f5d9](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961725000270/0000019617-25-000270-index.html), up from $158.104 billion for 2023-12-31 [E8f30d200ac](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961724000225/0000019617-24-000225-index.html). JPM net income for the fiscal period ended 2024-12-31 was $58.471 billion [Ef72c1b8ac5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961725000270/0000019617-25-000270-index.html), up from $49.552 billion for 2023-12-31 [E1f11e880fa](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961724000225/0000019617-24-000225-index.html).

## What was knowable then

As of the March 1, 2023 as-of date, annual financial results were available through the 2022 fiscal year [E390887daa0](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961723000231/0000019617-23-000231-index.html) [E386be707e9](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961723000231/0000019617-23-000231-index.html) [Ee1afe8035e](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085823000092/0000070858-23-000092-index.html) [E51defd2056](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085823000092/0000070858-23-000092-index.html). For fiscal year 2022, JPMorgan reported revenue of $128,695,000,000 and net income of $37,676,000,000 [E390887daa0](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961723000231/0000019617-23-000231-index.html) [E386be707e9](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961723000231/0000019617-23-000231-index.html). For the same period, Bank of America reported revenue of $94,950,000,000 and net income of $27,528,000,000 [Ee1afe8035e](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085823000092/0000070858-23-000092-index.html) [E51defd2056](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085823000092/0000070858-23-000092-index.html). Operating income and capital expenditures were unavailable for both institutions due to missing XBRL tags in the retrieved data [E520eca78d5] [E310db47641] [Ea85cd7d8ec] [Ece97180a89].

## What happened later

For the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, JPMorgan reported annual revenue of $177,556,000,000 and net income of $58,471,000,000 [E330195f5d9](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961725000270/0000019617-25-000270-index.html) [Ef72c1b8ac5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961725000270/0000019617-25-000270-index.html). For the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, Bank of America reported annual revenue of $101,887,000,000 and net income of $27,132,000,000 [Ebec3e73b7e](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085825000139/0000070858-25-000139-index.html) [Eedd1806b08](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085825000139/0000070858-25-000139-index.html). Operating income and capex metrics remained absent through the outcome cutoff window due to missing XBRL tags [E5498d85d67] [E6e7c7dd7b9] [E6e49a863e0] [E68c725b7c3].

## The peer test

Comparing the latest annual periods through the outcome cutoff, JPMorgan reported annual revenue of $177,556,000,000 for the period ending 2024-12-31 and net income of $58,471,000,000 [E330195f5d9](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961725000270/0000019617-25-000270-index.html) [Ef72c1b8ac5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961725000270/0000019617-25-000270-index.html). Bank of America reported annual revenue of $101,887,000,000 for the period ending 2024-12-31 and net income of $27,132,000,000 [Ebec3e73b7e](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085825000139/0000070858-25-000139-index.html) [Eedd1806b08](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085825000139/0000070858-25-000139-index.html). Both entities share identical fiscal year-end calendars (2024-12-31), though operating income and capex coverage gaps persist for both banks [E5498d85d67] [E6e7c7dd7b9] [E6e49a863e0] [E68c725b7c3].

## Cross-examination

Retrieved management passages as of the as-of date comprise qualitative or policy-oriented statements, such as expected VaR exception frequencies, tax asset timing, funding risk mitigation, stress capital buffers, and Net Zero Banking Alliance target schedules [E7ce6603664](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085823000092/bac-20221231.htm) [E0d67473ad4](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085823000092/bac-20221231.htm) [E3555faa25c](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085823000092/bac-20221231.htm) [E70c6dd32d0](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085823000092/bac-20221231.htm) [E10f008d3a7](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085822000131/bac-20220930.htm) [E993cdb488f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085822000112/bac-20220630.htm) [E39ec4895b2](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085822000112/bac-20220630.htm) [E04cd72b294](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085822000112/bac-20220630.htm) [Ed12643eb1e](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085822000112/bac-20220630.htm). No specific quantitative financial guidance or revenue/earnings growth targets for 2024 were retrieved for either bank, meaning these statements do not function as testable financial forecasts under strict claim-matching criteria.

## Limits

- Operating income and capital expenditures are unavailable for both JPMorgan and Bank of America due to missing XBRL tags in the retrieved data.
- No specific quantitative financial guidance or revenue/earnings growth targets for 2024 were retrieved for Bank of America or JPMorgan Chase as of 2023-03-01.
